programs.summary: Self-custodial stablecoin-funded Visa Signature card in Karta Personal. Current Karta card terms identify Third National as issuer; digital-asset collateral is held in the linked-wallet structure described by the terms, with virtual and physical cards for supported users.

USDPT-backed secured Visa card and digital wallet launched by Western Union with Rain. Western Union identifies Rain as card issuer and program manager for the current product disclosure; the reviewed legal terms separately identify Third National as issuer under Visa licence.

Stablecoin-funded USD Visa card integrated with SPay's wallet service. Current SPay disclosures identify Third National as issuer under licence from Visa and support USDT/USDC-funded spending; no exact original launch date is asserted.

relations.scope_note: Karta's current B2C card terms identify Third National as issuer. The terms effective date is not treated as the operational relationship start date.
Karta's current product and legal terms identify Visa Signature / Visa network support.

Western Union's launch and product disclosure identify Rain as card issuer for Stablecard. The separate legal terms use Third National wording; both first-party formulations are preserved in evidence rather than collapsed into a new legal-entity inference.
Western Union identifies Rain as program manager for Stablecard in addition to the issuer wording in its current product disclosure.
Western Union launch and legal materials identify Stablecard as a Visa secured card.
SPay's current product and privacy disclosures identify Third National as issuer. No exact relationship start date is inferred.
SPay identifies the current card as a USD Visa card issued under licence from Visa.

events.title: Karta terms document Third National and Visa secured-card generation
events.description: Karta B2C Card Terms effective May 5, 2026 identify Third National as issuer and describe the Visa secured-card and linked digital-asset-collateral structure. The date is an evidence milestone, not asserted as the original product launch or exact operational cutover date.

events.title: Western Union launches Stablecard with Rain
events.description: Western Union launched Stablecard on August 4, 2026 as a USDPT-backed secured Visa card and digital wallet in partnership with Rain. USDPT is issued by Anchorage Digital Bank on Solana; that stablecoin-issuer role is not promoted as a card-provider relation in this batch.
